lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAgrega \u003cb\u003ee:
"

Add electrons to the side with more positive charge to equalize the total charges. The electrons end up on the right in the oxidation and on the left in the reduction.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAsigna \u003cb\u003en:
"

Assign oxidation numbers and detect which species loses electrons (is oxidized) and which gains them (is reduced). The reducing agent is the one that is oxidized; the oxidizing agent, the one that is reduced. Change the reaction in “Lab” to see other cases.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eBalancea primero los:
"

First balance the atoms other than O and H; then oxygen with H₂O and hydrogen with H⁺. In basic medium, balance the same way and then add one OH⁻ for each H⁺ on both sides (or balance directly with OH⁻ and H₂O).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEscribe por separado:
"

Write the two half-reactions separately, with the species that contain the element that changes. They are not balanced yet: only the reactant and product of each are identified.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eMultiplica cada semir:
"

Multiply each half-reaction so that the electrons given up equal those gained, add them and cancel what appears on both sides. Check that atoms and charge are balanced.

"
